post.summary: Proxy: create a dedicated Baserow database and Results table for a task
post.description: Creates a database named `Figranium - <taskName> - <taskId>` in the given workspace, then creates a table named `Results` in it. Store the returned IDs in the task's `output` with `dedicated: true`. Requires a Baserow token that can create databases in the workspace.

taskName.description: Task name used in the database name. Truncated to 80 characters.

400.description: Invalid workspace ID or task ID (`INVALID_PROVISION_REQUEST`)

502.description: Baserow request failed. `BASEROW_PROVISION_FAILED` if the database wasn't created, or `BASEROW_TABLE_CREATION_FAILED` (with `databaseId`) if the database was created but the table wasn't.

get.summary: SSE stream of live execution updates
Load the full result of a trimmed execution
get.description: Returns the complete stored result for an execution whose history record was trimmed because it exceeded `MAX_PERSISTED_EXECUTION_BYTES` (default 256 KB). Trimmed records have `result.hasFullResult` set to `true`. Accepts a session or an API key.

404.description: `EXECUTION_NOT_FOUND` when the execution does not exist, or `FULL_RESULT_NOT_AVAILABLE` when no full result is stored for it

post.summary: Stop a running or queued execution
post.description: Requests a stop for a running execution. If the run is still waiting in the execution queue, it is cancelled before it starts, and the original run request responds with `{ "outcome": "stopped", "logs": ["Execution stopped while queued."] }`.

get.description: Without query parameters, returns the complete catalog as an array. Supplying any query parameter returns a paginated `{ items, total }` object of template summaries. Summaries omit `configuration`, `readme`, and `expected_output`, and include `action_count`. Requires a signed-in workspace session.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of summaries to return.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of matching templates to skip.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Exact category to filter by, or `all`.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Case-insensitive search across title, description, author name, category, and target URL.

200.description: Full catalog (no query parameters) or a page of template summaries

get.description: Returns a template with its workflow `configuration`, `readme`, and `expected_output`. Requires a signed-in workspace session.

400.description: `INVALID_TEMPLATE_ID`: the ID is not a UUID
